title: God Remembered Noah
text: But God remembered Noah and all the animals and livestock that were with him in the ark. …

title: An Olive Leaf
text: And behold, the dove returned to him in the evening with a freshly plucked olive leaf in her beak. …

title: Kind by Kind
text: Every living creature, every creeping thing, and every bird—everything that moves upon the earth—came out of the ark, kind by kind.

title: Seedtime and Harvest
text: As long as the earth endures, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night shall never cease.

title: My Rainbow in the Clouds
text: I have set My rainbow in the clouds, and it will be a sign of the covenant between Me and the earth.

title: The Window of the Ark
text: After forty days Noah opened the window he had made in the ark …

title: The Tops of the Mountains
text: … the tops of the mountains became visible.

title: Enthroned over the Flood
text: The LORD sits enthroned over the flood; the LORD is enthroned as King forever.

title: Fill the Earth
text: Be fruitful and multiply and fill the earth.

title: Every Living Creature
text: … every living thing that came out of the ark.
